<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant monoisotopic peak at m/z 127.10 with a decreasing series of M+1, M+2, etc., spaced by ~1.003 Da and with relative intensities matching the natural 13C abundance—we can definitively identify carbon (C) in the sample. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
